facts.text: I am trying to sort out my finances and set up a budget for my living expenses in Melbourne.
I transferred all my funds from my old bank account back home to my new Australian bank account on April 1st.
I am starting from scratch with my finances after transferring my funds.
My monthly income is around $2,500 AUD from my scholarship.
I am concerned about overspending on food because I am still getting used to prices in Australia.
I want tips on saving money on groceries and dining out.
I have been thinking about getting a part-time job to supplement my scholarship.
I am studying International Business.
I have some experience in marketing and writing.
I think freelancing or online tutoring could be a good fit for me.
I want to avoid overcommitting and compromising my studies.
I need tips on prioritizing tasks and managing my time effectively.
I am updating my resume and LinkedIn profile to look for job opportunities on campus.
I plan to look for job opportunities on campus.
I have used Trello before for group projects.
I like the idea of creating a master calendar and setting clear goals and objectives.
I appreciate reminders to take breaks and practice self-care to maintain my mental and physical health.
I am an international student and I am not sure how freelancing or online tutoring will affect my tax situation.
I want to know whether I need to pay taxes on my freelance income.
I want to know whether there are specific tax forms I need to file.
